thread.title: Dow Tumbles 461 Points on Apple, Goldman Weakness

title: Dow Tumbles 461 Points on Apple, Goldman Weakness
text:
Dow Tumbles 461 Points on Apple, Goldman Weakness By Nov. 12, 2018 1:47 p.m. ET Order Reprints Illustration by Michael Haddad Text size
1:42 p.m. The Dow Jones Industrial Average was getting hit hard as Apple (AAPL) stumbled, Goldman Sachs Group (GS) tumbled, and investors fretted about the strength of the U.S. dollar.
The S&P 500 has fallen 1.54% to 2738.21, while the Dow has dropped 461.67 points, or 1.78%, to 25,527.63. The Nasdaq Composite has slumped 2.44% to 7226.24.
The day got off to a bad start, when Lumentum Holdings (LITE) said that one of its suppliers– presumably Apple –had cut orders for “laser diodes for 3-D sensing.” It continued to get worse as Goldman suffered its worst two-day stretch since 2011 with a 10.6% decline...and counting. And don’t forget the U.S. dollar, which broke through 97 to hit its highest level in more than a year.
Of course, hanging over all this is the U.S. Federal Reserve, which will probably raise interest rates at its December meeting , the trade war with China, and even the possibility that gridlock is not good for the U.S. economy.
In other words, it’s a truckload of trouble.
